title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_martin_luther_by_heinz_schilling_xt6xe (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_martin_luther_by_heinz_schilling_xt6xe' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by its installation.
